notes.title: Planet of the Ants: NextFest Live!! Developer Livestream
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447342/08b600e722d544bbe8def49dfed1826a21ac074e.png"][/img][/p][p]In this scheduled livestream, I'll be going over the basics of my new Action Strategy game, Planet of the Ants. I'll talk about the theory behind the gameplay, the vision for the game and what's in store for the future. If you like what you see, I'd appreciate if you gave it a wishlist, it helps gauge interest in the game.[/p][p][/p][p]If you don't like it, let me know what you didn't like so we can work it out :)[/p][p][/p][p]Hope to see you there![/p]
